name: Swiss Weather Forecast
userDescription: Swiss weather forecasts for a postal code (data: MeteoSwiss): forecast tables for scenes and four signal child devices.
_comment_deviceIcon: Optional: ID of a built-in HC3 device icon (GET /api/icons), applied on import.
_comment_variables: postalCode and thresholds are user configuration. forecast10m, forecastHourly, forecast3h and forecastDaily contain JSON tables for scenes. Tests enforce that App.CONFIG and this list match.
_comment_ui: Rows of elements, top to bottom. Types: label, button. Texts here are English; App.UI translates them at start. A button's events (default onReleased) call QuickApp:ui<id><Event>, e.g. uibtnRefreshOnReleased - the HC3 enforces this name on import, so it must exist in src/main.lua.

ui.text: Location: set postalCode in QuickApp variables

_comment_files: Project files in load order, after the library in src/lib/files.json. The isMain file must be last.
